annotation.title_clean: Komise zveřejnila pokyny k definici systému UI s cílem usnadnit uplatňování pravidel prvního aktu o UI
annotation.title_en: The Commission publishes guidelines on AI system definition to facilitate the first AI Act's rules application
annotation.summary_en: European Commission news item (6 Feb 2025) announcing non-binding guidelines on the definition of an "AI system" under the EU AI Act. The guidelines help providers decide whether software counts as an AI system. They were published alongside guidelines on prohibited AI practices, after the first AI Act rules took effect on 2 February 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines help providers determine whether a software system is an AI system under the AI Act
Guidelines are non-binding and will be updated as practical experience and new use cases arise
Published together with guidelines on prohibited AI practices
First AI Act rules (AI system definition, AI literacy, prohibitions) applied from 2 February 2025
AI Act classifies AI systems into risk categories: prohibited, high-risk, transparency obligations
